# Source77 LLC Store

> Source77 Store (source77llc.com) is a small online store run by Source77 LLC
> in San Antonio, Texas. It sells inspected, condition-noted merchandise:
> car parts, home goods, electronics, tools, toys, clothing, books, and
> digital downloads. Every item is looked at and condition-noted before it
> goes up for sale. Prices are in US dollars.

## Shopping

- Browse all items: https://source77llc.com/shop.html
- Shop by category: https://source77llc.com/shop.html?category=Car+Parts
  (also Home Goods, Electronics, General Merchandise, Digital Downloads)
- Product pages: https://source77llc.com/product.html?id=item-NNN
- Books (original coloring books by Source77, on Amazon):
  https://source77llc.com/books.html
- Free living-trusts guide (general information, not legal advice):
  https://source77llc.com/trusts.html
- Digital downloads (instant download after payment):
  https://source77llc.com/shop.html?category=Digital+Downloads
- About the store: https://source77llc.com/about.html
- Contact: https://source77llc.com/contact.html

## Pickup and shipping

- Free local pickup: H-E-B, 17439 Classen Rd, San Antonio, TX 78247.
- Shipping by total cart weight: under 1 lb $5.99, 1-5 lb $8.99, over 5 lb $12.99.
- Texas sales tax (8.25%) applies to taxable orders.
- Digital products are delivered instantly after payment; no shipping.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Product prices, stock, and availability change often; always read the live
  product page or the store's product API before quoting a price or stock
  status to a shopper.
- Sold-out items stay listed with an "Out of stock" notice; do not treat a
  listed item as available unless the live page says it is in stock.
- The store does not sell Herbalife products directly; its Herbalife page
  links out to the official Herbalife site.
